title: LA Strong
description: "LA STRONG" is a powerful opening video televised before Los Angeles City Council meetings, capturing the devastation caused by the recent January fires and windstorms—from chaos and destruction to courage and community. Through dramatic footage, emotional sound bites, and moments of unity, the film shows how Angelenos came together to recover, rebuild, and stand strong. #LAStrong
